title: Often Done
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：often　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 often 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Often, in 1970 the elder checked the staff at the gate, and everybody in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: before the November rains the elder had ② often checked the staff, and nobody had asked a single question. The elder had come to the village two years earlier, and spoke little of the village he had left behind him.

The memoir for November 1964 puts it plainer. The staff was ③ often late, and the youth who kept it had ④ often kept it twice before the winter came; nothing in the village was ever done often in those days. The youth wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant something else. He checked the staff ⑤ more often than anybody else in the village, and of all who checked it that year he checked it ⑥ the most often of all of them. He was not a man who explained himself, and the village had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the memoir. What the line asked for was that the staff be kept ⑦ often every year, and that whoever did it be ⑧ often careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done often.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980 she checked the staff ⑨ often in the rain when nobody else would, and ⑩ Often, she said in 1982, that was the part the village never forgot; the memoir still speaks often of it. She kept the staff in the same gate for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the village never forgot how often it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 常常（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had often checked …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 常常（修饰形容词：often late）
C. adv. 经常（评注性状语，置于句首：Often, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 经常（修饰过去分词：had often kept it）
E. adv. 常常（比较级 more often than：拿叔叔跟村子里其他人相比）
F. adv. 常常（最高级 the most often of all of them：那个年头所有人之中的比较）
G. adv. 经常（被动结构中的中位状语：be kept often）
H. adv. 经常（修饰形容词：be often careful about the whole business）

answers.why: often 意为“常常”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Often, in 1970 …。
often 意为“常常”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had often checked the staff。
often 意为“常常”，此处修饰形容词 late（迟）：was often late。
often 意为“经常”，此处修饰过去分词 kept：had often kept it twice。
often 意为“常常”，拿叔叔跟村子里所有人相比，故用比较级 more often than。
often 意为“常常”，那个年头里所有人当中他做得最甚，故用最高级 the most often of all of them。
often 意为“经常”，被动结构 be kept often 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
often 意为“经常”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be often careful about the whole business。
often 意为“常常”，1980 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次检查那件短短的拐杖，副词置于动词之后。
often 意为“经常”，母亲 1982 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Often, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，长者经常在村口检查那件短短的拐杖；村子里人人都说那是头一回。（Often, …）
雨季到来之前，长者已经常常检查那件短短的拐杖。（had often checked …）
那件短短的拐杖当时常常迟。（often late）
保管它的那位后生在入冬前已经经常把它守着过两回。（had often kept it）
叔叔做这件事比村子里任何人都来得常常。（more often than …）
在那个年头里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最常常。（the most often of all of them）
answers: Often, in 1970 the elder checked the staff at the gate.
Before the November rains the elder had often checked the staff.
The youth who kept it had often kept it twice before the winter came.
He checked the staff more often than anybody else in the village.
Of all who did it that year, he did it the most often of all of them.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 often 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Often, in 1970 the elder checked the staff, and nobody forgot it.
Before the November rains the elder had often checked the staff.
The staff was often late, or so the memoir says.
The youth had often kept it twice before the winter came.
My mother checked the staff often in the rain when nobody else would.
Often, the village never forgot that part of the story.
